author: cableguy3333
quote: Game is a giant turd just like all the devs, if u never played a gta game, go play 4 or 5 both look as good but 900% better

author: cableguy3333
quote: A great game, combat is top tier, games main issue is invisible walls which makes exploration anoying, there are lots of areas to discover so exploration is mandatory but where you can and cant go is unclear. The critics saying a lack of exploration clearly never got past the 1st chapter which does feel very linear and i would say the hardest chapter in the game which is probably why they quit

author: cableguy3333
quote: Updated review, this is without question the best multiplayer shooter on the market as of April 2020, it still has some crashing bugs but that's about the only issues with this game now. Solo story is fun but very short it's all about the online game. Unlike every other online shooter there is no hiding in a house for 15minutes before you do anything, there is no hoping you find a decent gun, there is no worry of running out of ammo, it's just more full on then any other game. Nearly all the problems that came with launch are gone, loot boxes are gone and replaced with a progression system and this all takes place in beautiful enviroments that are all easily recognisable from the films, best lightsabre fights you will find anywhere when two good players face off. If you dont give this a go it's your loss not mine edit: 22/11/2021 played Halo but this game is still more fun

author: cableguy3333
quote: If you like Far Cry games you will like this one. Personaly I think 5 is my favourite as I think there was more variety but I am not even half way through the map and 20 hours in so that could change, if you do nearly everything then this is a 50+ hour game solo. Combat is great fun and challenging and that's the main reason to play a Far Cry game. There are races but these lack a challenge in the sense of skill but the bugs will stop you winning ( dont get stuck on a stone or maybe a curb ), these could of been fun but because of the 2 reasons I have mentioned they are not. The main bad dudes, not as good as far cry 5 and they do look like they imported the models from far cry 5 to populate this game. Apart from the humans who look fine the rest of the game looks amazing

author: cableguy3333
quote: As a fan of darksouls I got a ps5 for demonsouls and bloodborne, wow what a disappointment with both. Bloodborne is not in the same league as darksouls, sure the graphics are nice but as a challenge there isn't one, basically it's the same fight over and over again untill you get to Kos then its a change of tactics and its finished. This has been dumbed down for casuals hence the high score, stats hmm such a vast array to choose from ( sarcasm ) , clothing items sure if you like black, you start with the saw weapon and there is no reason to change it, you also get a gun just chuck that in the bin it's useless and equip a torch it's more useful. Most of the enemies all look the same and that includes the bosses. As far as I know this is the only from soft game with noises a child would make, Kos please stop screaming but he's not the most anoying, the most anoying is the 2nd to last boss who shouts Bam every 10 seconds, just shut the **** up and one last one some dude just runs about a building talking about Kos, that boss was just plain anoying. Anyone who says this game is hard has clearly been using a summons while playing darksouls. Blind playthrough i died once by the time I had killed the 3rd boss, most bosses are either a first or 2nd attempt. If you want and easier challenge than dark souls then sure go for it but if you're looking for something of similar or harder then stear well clear. It's still an ok game, I just found it a bit boring by the end

author: cableguy3333
quote:
Just played and completed this game, it was a massive struggle to finish
game due to being so bored by the end. The first 3 hours of this game
are amazing but then it drops off a cliff to reveal a game that is the
same thing all the way through. I would suggest to anyone to play the
first 3 hours but then just to turn it off as you will have seen what
game has to offer by this point. Climbing sounds fun but its not, please
stop making games with this tedious mechanic, tagging enemies is
another boring mechanic. Dont forget you can scan everything, please no
more of this, if you like reading there is plenty of it in this game,
you can collect hundreds of collectables, purpose unknown, you know a
game is bad when a world is full of these. The main characters are
extremely well wrote and that is this games biggest attraction, the rest
of it is meh

author: cableguy3333
quote: Review 2021 first ever playthrough. So I've played the trilogy in the reverse order and after playing the 2nd one I wasn't expecting much from this but how wrong was I. It's not only the best dragon age game, its one of the best games I've ever played and I've played alot. This is a rare epic game and cant believe I missed out on this when it first came out but what a treat for 2021. A better story that witcher 3 and better told which is hard to believe. On normal difficulty combat is certainly a challenge and if you ramp the level up you have a game that is so much harder than anything dark souls can throw at you. The game itself is massive, so much voice dialogue and the chats between your companions are genuinely funny to the point you want to take out different groups together just to hear what they have to say to each other. Combat I played as a mage and nearly always 3 out of 4 of my team were mages just because I found using a melee character terrible, I'm sure they are ok if you play with them but my sum total was about 10 minutes out of 50+hours. Graphics maybe a bit dated but still nicer to look at than cyberpunk2077 and the cutscene battles epic should be made into a film. If you have not played this dont be like me get it now, choices you make really do have a major impact and the decisions are sometimes a very hard choice, its a game that makes you feel sad its all over at the end

author: cableguy3333
quote: You want me to what ? parry ? well that's new to me and I dont want to so I wont be playing anymore of this nonsense. Honestly I could give the game a 0 but as huge lover of the developer via the dark souls games I wont. I've completed ds3 and ds1 ng+2 and still counting and I've never parried anything, I tried it once in ds 3 got hit a couple of times to my 1 hit and decided that was dumb so I never did it again, I played using just a sword and no shield unless you count the grass one strapped to my back never to be removed but there you have it, melee you have 3 options, dodge, parry or block and also in my opinion order of effectiveness, Sekiro has one class and one option parry parry parry. So if you like to parry sure you will probably love it, but if parrying is boring to you then stear well clear you will be disappointed, also I find parrying such a ridiculous idea, sure against fellow humans but against giants and such are you having a laugh, i guarantee you parry anything from a giant your end up the other side of the country it's like a truck is driving right at you, do you a) jump out the way or b) try to deflect it with a piece of metal, I don't care how big the lump of metal is you are holding, you wont be holding it for long

author: cableguy3333
quote: What cyberpunk should of been. So the game is set in London in the near future and it actually looks like London in the future. Unlike cyberpunk this game is fully open world , you can go up or down pretty much anywhere, very few loading screens, a vast majority of buildings can be entered and explored, combat can be a challenge. It took me ages to complete mainly due to me going round and recruiting the perfect recruits. If anyone has seen Allo Allo then I was was trying to make my team just like the resistance in that although that was scuppered when I had to seduce a woman and all I had was female operatives. Great fun, good story with a good twist, Could be a 10 but I dont think its quite epic enough

author: cableguy3333
quote: Not as good or hard as ds3, for a game that is supposed to be hard I found this remarkably easy. I kind of went to the wrong area first halfway through and while it made that section a little more tricky it left me overpowered for the rest of the game, bosses just died from me looking at them. There are several bosses in ds3 that took many hours to overcome, the hardest boss here took 5 attempts, I mean come on lego games give more of a challange. There is one really anoying boss arguably the easiest and hardest at the same time, just requires pure luck which any player can have. This game is fun and I highly reccomend but it's not close to being as good or testing as ds3

author: cableguy3333
quote: Dreadful buggy mess, one particular mission wouldn't complete so I left and spent 5 or 6 hours doing other missions. Came back to this one as had nothing left to do and the guy ran up to me eventually. Final bit of mission was to leave the area but this guy would not leave he would just run up to the boudary and stop meaning I could not progress the story any further. Game just isn't fun enough to warrant going back 5 hours + so that where this game ends

author: cableguy3333
quote: Building a theme park is great fun but once you park gets to a certain size it will constantly crash making it unplayable. Tracking your staff is impossible and way too involved and slow to keep them happy so they quit constantly, who wants to manage staff in sandbox mode, answer is no one. Haven't played the challenge mode as all I wanted to do was build the biggest rollercoasters but as said you cant make use of all the space

author: cableguy3333
quote: Zelda the legend of dark souls. Forget the disappointing cyberpunk this is easily the best game of 2020, on hard mode the first 10 hours or so will seem like you're playing an open world of dark souls, combat is beautiful in it's early stages, just like a ds game but on steroids, as you progress this will start to move towards a more hack and slash game but still challenging. Graphics are stunning and whats better been playing 20+ hours and not come across 1 bug, how amazing is that. Has an adult sense of humour but children wont get the jokes so it's family friendly much like a pixar cartoon. If you cant enjoy this game then no one can help you

author: cableguy3333
quote: Series x review, so this game is big, fun and broken. car driving is pretty bad so if you are going to travel go by bike as its pretty much the only time you will see your self created character in third party view. Gun combat is fun but mostly pointless as once once you have worked out how to equip that sword you found it's game over for enemies in your way. So many bugs in this game, some game breaking like not being able to draw a weapon, some random deaths, I got on a bike it did nothing, I got on the bike next to it , rode for about 50 meters before it blew up and I flew to the outer edges of the badlands in what must have been a nuke exploding. Not being able to select different dialogue options and having to go with the first one, the bugs are endless much like the area of Night city, there are many things you can do but probably wont, like scanning and hacking, yeah you can do it but why when you can just run in slash evertyone with a sword and be out again in 2 minutes with another bag of cash, you might want to go the non lethal route but with a sword you say, there is an eye implant that turns all your weapons to non lethal ,not sure what magic they use here but it works, sword no longer dices enemies into pieces. lots of missions are thrown at you and trying to workout what they all are is pretty hard to the point I just used my map and went to the closist one which is not very RPG, Characters in main story are well created although Keanu Reeves still cant act, if you're the type of player that likes to grind for an item then this game will get it's hooks into you as there are hundreds of things to upgrade or buy. Graphics are not Red Dead standard or even GTA V and while its big I'm not sure it's much bigger than watchdogs legion ( I could be wrong ) but that has far more impressive graphics, sometimes it actually looks like it has last last generation roots. But on a whole I'm enjoying this far more than Valhalla

author: cableguy3333
quote: Anyone who gives this game a higher score hasn't played it for long, game breaking bugs, unholly father being one of them.

author: cableguy3333
quote: I have over 100 hours and the 50 million achievement and all I can say is it's unplayable garbage once you are dealing with large hospitals, it's as if they only tested a couple of hospitals at early stages. Bugs are plentiful from npcs getting stuck, npcs not doing the jobs they are asked, not being able to select jobs for janitors in staff and training rooms, selecting a doctor in the menu and then suddenly you're in control of a nurse, characters not learning in training rooms, the list is endless. As for the actual gameplay it's extremely repetative but addictive and the depth of the game is very shallow, the actual game is not challenging but with the bugs it becomes a mighty challenge verging on impossible if you want 3 stars in every hospital, then again if you're only interested in 1 star hospitals you will probably miss most of these issues

author: cableguy3333
quote:
It's a rockstar game so you expect perfection which in the solo campaine it certainly achieves new heights on graphics and gameplay. You know the story by now so no point telling you about it but if you haven't played this then you are certainly missing out. The online mode is just boring don't expect a gta v here, there is nothing to do apart from killing other people.
Update nov 2019 Online is much better now, but the worst thing about this game is it makes all your other games worse. I find my self playing other games thinking this looks pants, which before rdr2 came out I wouldn't have. So some new advice if you like other games dont play this game it will make them worse than they are but you will also miss out on the best game ever made

author: cableguy3333
quote: If you dont like Tomb Raider then you will hate this. This wasn't what I was expecting but I enjoyed it. Its basicaly Lara Croft with a lightsaber. There are stormtroopers but so few it could be any random game. Content wise there is far less than Battlefront 2 although it will take longer to complete but that's only because of puzzles and alot of backtracking, you will constantly be looking at your map which is anoying. On hard level when you do find something to fight it is fun and challenging but most of your time will be spent jumping about and using previously mentioned said map. Cut scenes and story are great but have to say I'm left a bit dissappointed, while Battlefront was panned by critics and players it still remains on my xbox where as this is an instant delete after completion as there is nothing to do after completion or a reason to play through again, best advice wait for a sale

author: cableguy3333
quote: Ok so it's not quite a 10 due to graphics not being of rdr2 quality but other than that this game is fantastic and at times pretty hard. Combat is so different to what you find in most games and while somewhat frustrating when you first start playing it does make you feel you are learning something like swordfighting rather than just press the same button over and over again untill you do a 200 ninja move on someone. There's a lot of moaning about lock picking all I can say is after you have unlocked the first couple it's very easy. This proper RPG rivals The Witcher 3, it's not as big but combat is a far better experience and archery you have no sight which makes trying to hit things when you dont sit square on to your TV interesting

author: cableguy3333
quote:
It's a mad max, doom and farcry amalgamation, combat is great fun although even on hard mode it's not challenging most the time, most of the hard bits you will have to search for with little reward apart from the enjoyment of a tricky boss or group of shrouded. Although Bethesda had nothing to do with the developement it is published by them so you expect bugs and it doesn't dissappoint with enemies stuck running into walls or thin air and you getting stuck in a car where the only option is saving and reloading plus you can expect ripoff dlc in the future. Graphics are not great but not bad either. Best weapon in game assault rifle, when do you get it ? right at the start so there is little point gathering other weapons or upgrading them. Vehicles, promo says if you can see it you can drive it, I've seen plenty of boats cant drive any so far, you start with the phoenix arguably the best land vehicle in game so really no point gathering others. Yes it's open world but as with nearly all open world games it just makes things easier and a bit of a drudge from one action spot to the next, searching for that last storage chest just so location shows as complete on map can be very frustrating where sometimes you think it's a lie and not there at all ( just a waste of your time ) This can be aided by spending a lot of perks in search & recover but unless you're going for 100% completion a bit pointless. This game is far from perfect and seems a bit rushed probably down to Bethesda forcing ID and Avalanche to release it to compensate them losing money on fallout 76 and whatever other garbage that company makes. If you go for the main questline right from the start you will miss much of the content and end up with a really short game. Sounds like I'm slating it but as FPS it's great fun but everything else around it is poor. The characters you meet are quickly forgettable to the point you will skip every conversation due to it just being painful to listen too.
Anyway if you want a FPS then you will have a great time here, but if you're looking for a great open world game then this is not it, maybe replay a GTA game or Red Dead 2 as these are the definition **** openworld game.

author: cableguy3333
quote: Great RPG many choices how to finish missions that do have an effect on the game. Graphics are Ok , not great not bad, controls are a bit clunky especially when looting. Combat is tough don't expect an assassins creed face roll combat system, dodge is important that's all I'm going to say. If you normaly play your games on hard or insane levels you will enjoy the challenge of this game, if you enjoy face roll game combat ( extremely easy ) then steer well clear of this game, you probably wont get past the first enemy. I will say game starts to lose it's appeal towards the end of the game and probably wont make you want to replay it even though there are many more outcomes but certainly worth atleast one playthrough

author: cableguy3333
quote: Totaly stitched up with this games high marks. It's basicaly a game from the 1980's with better graphics. First you can only save a game at end of each level but I only completed the first level which was very long and tedious. You are greeted with an old skool shoot em up that the graphics actually look like it was made in the 1980's, unlike games of the 80's you have no lives and have to start over if you die ( although it's not exactly difficult ) which is painful as you then have to wait for it to load again ( not sure why it takes so long ) after that it puts you in a kind of table top view of your character fighting robots still not hard and after that a type of 2d platformer which is still not hard ( give me me super mario bros on the snes all day long over this please ) anyway inbetween the tedious combat of just holding down the trigger and pointing you then get plenty of running through sections with nothing happening ( yawn fest ). The only good thing about this game is the main character you play which is actually drawn nice. The game is technically 3d but nearly always plays as 2D apart from the boss fight which again was a tedius long drawn out affair. Sorry to anyone who likes this game but to me it was incredibly boring and rivals Fallout 76 for how bad it is. You would probably be better off watching a film than playing this, it's not really a game
game_title: NieR: Automata - Become as Gods Edition

author: cableguy3333
quote: A fantasticaly hard game and by hard I mean brain power, this game is made for the interlectuals out there. There is no guidance and you can build pretty much anything you can think of, but will it fly ? probably not but the explosions are a joy to watch

author: cableguy3333
quote: It has an enjoyable solo campaign but the game doesn't have a steady climb rate of difficulty, instead has spikes of extremely hard bits in random bits of the game and possibly the hardest part of the game is right at the start trying to get off the beach which is certainly a no no for a game even though in reality this would be factually correct as alot of people died on those beaches

author: cableguy3333
quote: I missed this game the first time round must of been during my married years but played it this year. I played it for quite a long time before I realised I was bored. The story, I have no idea it got lost in the thousands of missions it gives you which are all spread out miles apart. The game is so full of bugs but it's Bethesda so that's expected, you can use mods to fix them but Bethesda has introduced a new way of scamming players by charging you to use mods. I just dont get the hype surrounding this game, maybe if I hadn't played withcer 3 or dragon age inquisition before it I may of enjoyed it more
game_title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

author: cableguy3333
quote: Another poor effort from CA they really are living off the back of Rome total war now. This game offers no challenge it's just easy. I won the long campaine without ever being the strongest faction or ever having to fight the strongest faction which just seems dumb. Some of the factions will have no involvement in your game what so ever. The graphics are stunning but that shouldn't be what a total war game is about

author: cableguy3333
quote: The game that made everyone keep paying CA for inferior games that followed. It's now been made to play on windows 10 and so I gave it another shot, after playing this for thousands of hours years ago I have racked up another 70 in just a few weeks. If you like a challenge this is probably the only total war game that can give you one, just select hard and play as Partha. Game is set during the Victorian age, just kidding obviously it's set around the time of the Roman empire, it has plenty of unique units and the map is large but not as big as Rome 2 or small as Warhammer so just right

author: cableguy3333
quote: Assassins creed for Goblins. It's actualy much better than any assassins creed game out there, if you end up in hand to hand to combat with anyone there's a good chance you will end up dead. It's also quite entertaining, go AFK for a while and you will hear an enjoyable song which actually made me laugh, I find a game very rarely that does that.

author: cableguy3333
quote: It's assassins creed so basically it's the same as every other assassins creed game that's gone before or after. Hand to hand combat is still meh .If you ever wanted to visit London then this is for you.

author: cableguy3333
quote: It's assassins creed so basically it's the same as every other assassins creed game that's gone before with the added thrill of ship combat. Hand to hand combat is still meh but ship combat actually gives you a challenge and this is probably the best part of game, as you would expect the map is stunning, if you ever wanted to visit Greece then this is for you.

author: cableguy3333
quote: It's assassins creed so basically it's the same as every other assassins creed game that's gone before, combat is still meh but the map is stunning, if you ever wanted to visit Egypt without the fear of terrorists then this is a game for you

author: cableguy3333
quote: Great fun and will keep you entertained for hours if you like shooting things and blowing stuff up. It gives a good challenge and has many side missions which are also fun and different like races and flying through rings with a wing suit, well worth a try if you haven't played before

author: cableguy3333
quote: What to say, it's better than fallout 76 but a lot worse than just cause 3. I didn't play it for long and that's because I just didn't like it even though I wanted to like it so much. Your targets are not that obvious and I found no way of getting ammo for your gun instead I kept having to change to whatever gun the last enemy was using. I only played this for a hour so take my review with a pinch of salt

author: cableguy3333
quote: This is an xbox review as there is no review page for xbox on this game. It's kind of world of warcraft during the vanilla years with much better graphics. Combat is fun and fast or that's what it seems at first but after a while it's just button bashing. Why I haven't scored it higher and that's because of it's pay to win system once PVP becomes involved

author: cableguy3333
quote: A good FPS nothing more nothing less, when the original Doom was released that was ground breaking this is not but fun never the less

author: cableguy3333
quote: This game is so boring, it offers no challenge and you will be bored before you get to the end, trying to find certain animals that you own can be extremely hard to impossible sometimes. Combat is probably the worst I have ever seen in this type of game, just click on the alarm and that's it. If you want a base builder/survivor game with a challenge then go buy Rimworld

author: cableguy3333
quote: A back to your roots for this franchise which is most welcome, the scary atmosphere is back along with the puzzles which when you play a resident eveil game that's all you really want. It is a bit on the short side.

author: cableguy3333
quote: It's big, fun and buggy, but then what game isn't buggy that Bethesda make. It's a good RPG and a solid FPS which certainly helps bump up the score on combat. Graphics are a bit outdated but then what Bethesda game doesn't have outdated graphics

author: cableguy3333
quote: Based in the same area as far cry 5 after the bombs drop, it's a totaly new game not just a dlc as some monkeys would have you believe. The main map is totaly different albeit smaller but there are new missions in different smaller maps. It's harder than it's predecessor which is always welcome

author: cableguy3333
quote: It's a great game, assassins creed with guns, built using the same engine you would expect that. It's fun and enjoyable my only issue is it's too easy and you have to complete it before doing it on a harder level and I rarely replay a game once finished

author: cableguy3333
quote: One of the worst games ever made. I have only played it for an hour in the final BETA version but it hasn't changed since then. The graphics are a decade out of date, everything is clunky and the story is non existent. PVP doesn't exist even though it's an online game only. This is the biggest scam in history which is no shock seeing as it comes from the greedy thieves over at Bethesda

author: cableguy3333
quote: If witcher 3 didn't exist then this would be a 10, this is a great RPG with better combat than witcher 3 but the stories aren't as good. So if you want a fantasy game with great combat then go for this

author: cableguy3333
quote: One of the best games ever made, it looks a bit cheap and that is why it only gets a 9, It is an amazing base builder/survivor with good combat, the AI is not daft making it quite hard which I always appreciate a challenge I hope you to as this will definitely give you one

author: cableguy3333
quote: This game was a 10 until they released flying bikes and made me stop playing. Solo story is great as you would expect from any rockstar game but online mode is even more enjoyable with many more missions all soloable but the most enjoyable part are the heists, only problem here is you will need friends or join a bunch a randoms and hope for the best.

author: cableguy3333
quote: One of the best games ever made, perfection was achieved with this game, if you haven't played it I guess you're an alien from another world, I suggest you download this quickly it will make a great story to take back to your planet

author: cableguy3333
quote: Great game incredibly short. What you get is 5 hours worth of content, game lasts 10 hours maximum and 50% of that is running through the same rooms over and over. There is no replay value what so ever. It is fun but just not worth the money.

author: cableguy3333
quote: Anyone who rates Resident Evil 2 higher than this game I would say ignore all their future reviews as they clearly don't know a game when they play one. Yes it has a few bugs some will have you shouting at the screen but that's only because you're enjoying it so much. **** had bugs and was rubbish you simply wouldn't play it but this game even with it's flaws is so addictive you put up with the bugs. Because of it's permadeath system there is no lets give that a go, nope that didn't work lets try a different way, instead you have to try and make it go perfect right off the bat or your favourite character may end up dead with no way of ever getting him/her back, once you're dead you stay dead just like if it was a real life apocalypse, decisions have to be made fast with no guidance, there is no sat nav so you need to know where you are going before you head out which may annoy anyone under 30 who can't read a map, this is no brain dead FPS your brain will be constantly active trying to think of multiple things to do at the same time which when you first start out may seem overwhelming. Sometimes ( quite alot actually ) you will have multiple missions with time limits that just aren't possible to do all of them so you have to decide who you abandon and who you save making everyones game uniquely different. Some people say there is no story ? Come on people if you woke up tomorrow in a zombie apocaylpse where is your story or would you be more worried where your next meal was coming from, I'm going to lean towards the the latter, the story is what you make it. If this game had no bugs it would be a 10. This a must buy for any intelligent humans out there but if you're a brain dead zombie then you might want to pop over to res 2 for your 5 hours of content.
